To determine the year with the highest average consumer confidence index, you would need to execute a SQL query that calculates the average of the confidence index for each year and then identifies the year with the maximum value. Here's how you could structure such a query:

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT YEAR,
       AVG(confidence_index) AS average_confidence
FROM Consumer
GROUP BY YEAR
ORDER BY average_confidence DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

This query groups the data by year, calculates the average confidence index for each group, sorts the results in descending order based on the average confidence index, and returns the top result (the highest value). The result will show you which year had the highest average consumer confidence.
